description: This file defines the UserDecorator class, which provides a wrapper around the User entity, offering methods to set related entities like Employee and UserRole, check for admin role, and handle non-hashed passwords.

classes.name: UserDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the User entity that provides utility methods to manipulate user-related data such as roles and employee associations, and to check administrative privileges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UserDecorator with a User entity.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Protected method that returns the associated User entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity on the User based on an employee number.

methods.name: setUserRoleById
methods.description: Assigns a UserRole to the User based on its ID.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user has an admin role.

methods.name: getNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the non-hashed password stored temporarily.
